  Do we need a plan? Yes — but a lightweight one, not a heavy design doc. The reason: this is ~100+ files of mechanical change that's only safe if shipped in reviewable slices (one concern per branch/PR), each verified by tsc + lint + build. A single mega-PR touching every file would be
  unreviewable and risky. The judgment calls (which inputs are real filters; dropdown focus order) are exactly what a checklist should pin down so it can be parallelized across agents without drift.

  My recommendation: merge the current verified batch first (it's a clean, self-contained unit), then work the rollout as tracked slices.

  Two decisions for you:
